# Plex

Plex serves the media library from the NAS.

## Library paths

<!-- kb-section: verified=2026-05-01; ttl=60; sources=observations/archived/20260903T120000-c3d4e5f6.md -->

The library lives under /srv/media. Do not move it while Plex is scanning.

## Transcoding

Transcoding uses a cache under /var/cache/plex.
